title: Owens' deaths: suicide, fullback ejected, crashes
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Owens' deaths: suicide, fullback ejected, crashes, about 1970s-1980s at Philadelphia Eagles game; USA, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
